name: Katekyo Shichao! ~Hitotsu Yane no Shita, Muhyohyo Gasshuku Monogatari~
original_name: カテキョしちゃお！ ～ひとつ屋根の下、むひょひょ合宿物語～
source:
I've always barely been capable of studying, even from a young age.

Although I somehow managed to make it to college, I could not keep up with the level around me, and my grades were on a downward spiral.

My family, who were worried about me, suggested that I give up my summer vacation and improve my academic skills.

My sister, her friend that goes to the same college, a senior, and my highschool teacher also came and stayed at a cottage in the countryside and it turned into a full-on training camp!

Under the same roof, a month-long cohabitation with the older women has begun!
